name: Researcher (ARCHITECT phase) → Reviewer (spec mode)
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 dev-via-spec arc terminal handoff. Fires when researcher-architect terminates with decide(action=emit) — the canonical forward terminal that closes the research arc and produces a spec-shaped artifact (emit_dev_via_spec_artifact). Replaces the legacy research-mode-transition/01a-research-to-reviewer-after-researcher.json + dev-via-spec/01-planner-to-reviewer.json + dev-via-spec/06-architect-emit-to-builder.json triangle (none of which fit the compressed researcher-as-architect role). The spawned reviewer loads the reviewer-spec/ persona fragments; chain.spec_mode_gate.proceed (written by phasevalidator.SpecModeGate after the reviewer-spec loop completes) gates the downstream spawn to builder.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.reviewer-spec
on_enter.prompt:
The researcher (ARCHITECT phase) at loop $entity.instance has emitted a spec artifact via emit_dev_via_spec_artifact + decide(action=emit). Spec path: $entity.triple.dev_via_spec.artifact.path. Spec slug: $entity.triple.dev_via_spec.artifact.slug.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to load the architect's narrative terminal (decide.reason + scratchpad). Then cat the rendered markdown via bash if you need the structured spec; the spec_path property points at the on-disk file.

Iteration 2 — apply the spec-mode evaluation contract (reviewer-spec/10-evaluation-contract.md + 30-checks-gate.md). Each check[] must bind to an evidence rule; every external-actor integration_point must have at least one check covering it. If all gates pass, call decide(action="approved", reason="<one-sentence summary citing the spec slug>"). If a gate fails, call decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of structural gaps>"). Use decide(action="needs_clarification", reason=..., retry_hint=...) only when the artifact's intent is genuinely ambiguous — chain.recovery.proceed (ADR-040) gates retries through 02-reviewer-rejected-retry-research.json.

metadata.pattern: dev-via-spec arc terminal: researcher-architect emits spec artifact → reviewer-spec evaluates → on approval, 02-reviewer-approved-to-builder.json fires (gated on chain.spec_mode_gate.proceed from phasevalidator.SpecModeGate)
metadata.spec_artifact_forwarding: The architect's emit_dev_via_spec_artifact stamps dev_via_spec.artifact.{path,slug} on the architect's loop entity. Rule 02's substitution `$entity.triple.dev_via_spec.artifact.path` resolves against the reviewer-spec entity (the rule's triggering entity), not the architect — so phasevalidator.SpecModeGate forwards these triples one hop from architect to reviewer-spec on the approved path. Without that forward, the builder spawn substitutes the literal token and bootstrap_workspace fails (beta.64 has no `exists` operator to gate defensively).
